summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature without running tests, per instructions. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] shape in ControlCode; rich/control.py adds the OSC 0 format entry (ESC ] 0 ; title BEL) and Control.title(title), which passes a single two-item tuple to the constructor; rich/console.py adds set_window_title, gated only on is_terminal, returning True when buffered and False otherwise, with the required docstring warnings; rich/_windows_renderer.py adds an elif branch that calls term.set_title(title) once for SET_WINDOW_TITLE; CHANGELOG.md gets an Added heading above Fixed with the PR 2200 bullet; tests added in test_console.py, test_control.py, and test_windows_renderer.py. Nothing was committed. Verification was by reading only: tests and mypy were not run.
